faq.q: What is the efficiency of a coal power station?
faq.a: Efficiency is useful energy out divided by energy in. Older coal stations turn about 33 to 38 percent of the coal's energy into electricity, and the newest high-temperature plants reach about 45 percent.
asks: How efficient is a coal plant?
How do you work out efficiency?

faq.q: Why does so much heat go into the cooling water?
faq.a: To get the most work out of steam, it has to be turned back into water at a low temperature in the condenser. That releases the hidden heat that originally boiled it, and every heat engine has to give away some heat like this.
asks: Why is so much energy lost in the condenser?

faq.q: Why are chimney gases a loss?
faq.a: The gases leaving the chimney are still well over 100 degrees Celsius, so they carry heat away. Engineers use them to warm the incoming air, but they cannot be cooled too far or acids condense and corrode the chimney.
asks: How much heat goes up the chimney?

faq.q: Why does a power station use its own electricity?
faq.a: Huge fans blow air into the furnace, mills grind the coal and pumps push water round at very high pressure. All of these run on electricity, using roughly 5 to 10 percent of what the station makes.

faq.q: Can the wasted heat be used?
faq.a: Yes, in combined heat and power stations the warm water heats homes and factories instead of being dumped, raising the useful share to 70 to 80 percent. It needs customers nearby, so most big stations simply cool it.
asks: Why not use the waste heat from power stations?

facts: Most coal power stations turn roughly a third of the fuel's energy into electricity sent to the grid.
Energy is conserved: the energy not turned into electricity ends up as heat in the surroundings.

quiz.say: A power station turns 100 joules of coal energy into 36 joules of electricity. What is its efficiency?
quiz.show: Efficiency with 36 J out of 100 J in?
quiz.why: Efficiency is useful energy out divided by energy in: 36 divided by 100 is 36 percent.

wrong.1: 64 percent is the share that is wasted, not the useful share.
wrong.2: Efficiency can never be more than 100 percent.

quiz.say: Where does the largest share of a coal station's energy end up?
quiz.show: Biggest share of the energy goes…
quiz.why: About half the energy leaves as heat in the cooling water when the steam is condensed.

wrong.0: Electricity is only about a third.
wrong.2: Chimney gases take about a tenth.
